run_f_gold: run f_gold to calculate minimum rotations needed to unlock a circular lock given input and unlock code
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample input and unlock code pairs to verify correct rotation count
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use string-based digit iteration instead of integer modulo arithmetic
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like single-digit inputs or codes with leading zeros
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum circular rotations per digit between input and unlock code
